acceptance: `evolve routing plan --cycle N` against a fake bridge prints the parsed plan and writes nothing under runs/cycle-N (red: unknown subcommand)
The prompt it sends equals the one the cycle composes for the same inputs (one composer, a test compares them)
An unknown cycle exits 1; an advisor launch failure exits 2 with the cause
fix: Add `evolve routing plan --cycle N [--goal-text T]`. It builds the advisor's input from cycle N's recorded state (or from the goal), runs the advisor through core/advisor's launcher and profile fallback chain, and prints the plan and its rationale. It writes nothing into the cycle. It reuses the cycle's prompt composer and plan parser rather than a copy. Exit 0; exit 1 for an unknown cycle; exit 2 when the advisor launch fails. Document it in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: `evolve routing` offers explain and replay (cmd_routing.go:18-25), both over a decision a cycle already recorded, and `evolve resolve-llm` maps one role to a CLI. Nothing asks the phase advisor to plan a given cycle or goal on demand. Checking how a routing, profile or phase-config change would plan a cycle therefore takes a live cycle.
title: `evolve routing` only explains a recorded decision; add `routing plan --cycle N` to ask the phase advisor for a plan without a cycle
